research_summary: The deadline-safe search confirmed that AFCON-bound players including Mbeumo would be unavailable from GW17. Later Friday Liverpool news was excluded because publication before the 11:00 cutoff could not be proven.

sources.title: FPL players now red-flagged for AFCON - will they miss Gameweek 16?
sources.citation_excerpt: These AFCON-bound players will not be available for selection for their clubs from Gameweek 17 onwards.
sources.claim_text: Bryan Mbeumo was unavailable to Manchester United from GW17 because he had departed for AFCON.
